mapper.sql: SELECT user_id , login_id , email , pw_hash , pw_salt , user_name , user_phone , birth_date , gender , disability_type , severity , address , is_share_location , is_share_result , is_sos_alert , created_at , updated_at FROM users
mapper.select: SELECT guardian_id , user_id , guardian_name , guardian_phone , guardian_relation , guardian_priority , is_notify , created_at FROM guardians WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY guardian_priority, guardian_id LIMIT 1
SELECT noti_id , noti_type , title , body , status , created_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, noti_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
